sources.title: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 pinned official release JSON
sources.locator: v5.0.0_release; commit 5cf9b032440be53ce345ab3c130fda46ba1ce7a2; selected native requirement IDs

limitations: 37 selected requirements out of 345; the remaining native IDs stay unmapped in web-assurance.mjs. The two modules have different curated denominators.
Application verification levels are international assessment targets, not country security grades. No national jurisdiction is inferred.
All selected application requirements require manual review; no scan-only certification is emitted. Feature exclusions require independent review.
Adapted from OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 under CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribution and modification details are in research/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
